(Capacity: 3,005) |champion= |tourney=[[2024 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result=first round }} {{2023–24 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2023–24 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of San Francisco]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Dons were led by second-year head coach [[Chris Gerlufsen]] and played their home games at the War Memorial Gymnasium at the [[Sobrato Center]] as members of the [[West Coast Conference]] (WCC). They finished the season 23–11, 11–5 in [[2023–24 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC play]], to finish in third place. As the No. 3 seed in the WCC tournament, they defeated [[2023–24 Portland Pilots men's basketball team|Portland]] in the quarterfinals, before losing to [[2023–24 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2024 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2023–24 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]]. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|Dons]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 20–14, 7–9 in [[2022–23 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC play]], to finish in a three-way tie for fifth place. In the [[2023 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] as the 6 seed, they defeated [[2022–23 Pacific Tigers men's basketball team|Pacific]] in the second round and [[2022–23 Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball team|Santa Clara]] in the quarterfinals before losing to [[2022–23 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] in the semifinals.
